records.subject: DATA
records.title: Introduction to Data Analytics
records.description:
Foundational course in data analytics covering statistical and mathematical principles, computational tools (Excel, Python, R), and reproducible workflows for data wrangling,
visualization, and communication.

records.subject: DATA
records.title: Computational Calculus I
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: MATH 106 and MATH 108 with a C or better or a minimum ALEKS math placement score of 83%.
records.description: Introduction to calculus concepts such as limits, derivatives, and integrals with a focus on computational methods including the application of programing in hands on projects including numerical differentiation, integration, and Taylor series.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: DATA
records.title: Computational Calculus II
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: DATA 121, or MATH 171 with a C or better.
records.description: Computational calculus emphasizing multivariable and vector calculus, optimization, and advanced visualization techniques including topics of partial derivatives, multiple integrals, parametric equations, and optimization algorithms using Python in real-world data analytics scenarios.

records.subject: DATA
records.title: Introduction to Text Analysis
records.description: Introduction to computational and statistical text analysis using the open source programming language R; designed for students with no prior experience with programming but who wish to extend their methodological tool kit to include quantitative and computational approaches to the study of text.  (Crosslisted course offered as DTC 204, DATA 204.)

records.subject: DATA
records.title: Visualizing Data
records.description: Introduction to the tools and methods of visually communicating data for diverse audiences and scenarios.  (Crosslisted course offered as DTC 209, DATA 209.)

records.subject: DATA
records.title: Data Structures for Data Analytics
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: CPT S 121, CPT S 131, CS 121 or DATA 122 or concurrent enrollment; DATA 115 or concurrent enrollment.
records.description: Programming techniques including data structures, sorting and searching, object-oriented design, and an introduction to algorithmic analysis.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: DATA
records.title: Linear Algebra with Modern Applications
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: MATH 106 or 201 with a C or better, or MATH 140, 171, 202 or DATA 121 or higher or concurrent enrollment, or a minimum ALEKS math placement score of 80%.
records.description: Solving linear systems, matrices, determinants, subspaces, eigenvalues, orthogonality, machine learning, AI, computer graphics, and economic models.  (Crosslisted course offered as MATH 225, DATA 225.)  Credit not granted for more than one of MATH 225, 220, and 230.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: DATA
records.title: Introduction to R
records.description: Hands-on knowledge and skills for programming, handling different types of data, data cleaning, and visualization; excellent foundation for courses or projects that involve coding in R.

records.subject: DATA
records.title: Introduction to Python
records.description: Hands-on knowledge and skills for working with real data and the Python programming language; an excellent foundation for later coursework in the Data Analytics major.

records.subject: DATA
records.title: Introduction to SQL - The Structured Query Language
records.description: Hands-on knowledge and skills for basic-to-advanced aspects of the SQL system.

records.subject: DATA
records.title: Professional Development for Data Analytics
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: DATA 219 or concurrent enrollment with junior standing; admitted to the major in Data Analytics.
records.description: Professional development for data analytics students, emphasizing career preparation, internship search strategies, resume and interview skills, and engagement with industry professionals to understand workplace expectations and pathways into the field.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: DATA
records.title: Model-based and Data-based Methods for Data Analytics
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: DATA 219, CPT S 215, CPT S 223, or CPT S 233; MATH 220 or MATH/DATA 225; STAT 360.
records.description: Modeling methods for data analysis with high dimensional data, including theoretical and practical concerns.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: DATA
records.title: Data Repository Systems for Data Analytics
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: CPT S 215, CPT S 223, CPT S 233, or DATA 219; DATA 303; MATH 220, or MATH/DATA 225; admitted to the major in Data Analytics; junior standing.
records.description: Introduction to repository systems and use of data repositories for data wrangling.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: DATA
records.title: Probability and Statistics
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: MATH 140, 171, 202, or DATA 121 each with a C or better, or MATH 172 or 182.
records.description: Probability models, sample spaces, random variables, distributions, moments, comparative experiments, tests, correlation and regression in engineering applications. Credit not granted for both STAT 360 and 370.  (Crosslisted course offered as STAT 360, DATA 360.)

records.subject: DATA
records.title: Special Topics I
records.prerequisiteText: Course prerequisite: Admitted to the major in Data Analytics; junior standing.
records.description: Skills and concepts for analyzing real data using coding software.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: DATA
records.title: Corporate Data Analytics
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: DATA 324; STAT/DATA 360; STAT/DATA 435 or concurrent enrollment; admitted to the major in Data Analytics; junior standing.
records.description: Project-based class that integrates the main aspects of data analytics.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: DATA
records.title: Data Analytics Capstone
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: CPT S/CS 315 or DATA 319; STAT/DATA 360; DATA 422; STAT/DATA 435 or 437, or concurrent enrollment; admitted to the major in Data Analytics; junior standing.
records.description: Team-based project that integrates the main aspects of data analytics.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: DATA
records.title: Statistical Modeling for Data Analytics
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: STAT/DATA 360 or STAT 370, either with a C or better.
records.description: Multiple linear regression with model selection, dealing with multicollinearity, assessing model assumptions, the LASSO, ridge regression, elastic nets, Loess smoothing, logistic regression, Poisson regression, and the application of the bootstrap to regression modeling.  (Crosslisted course offered as STAT 435, DATA 435.)
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: DATA
records.title: High Dimensional Data Learning and Visualization
records.description: Data visualization, metric-based clustering, probabilistic and metric-based classification, algebraic and probabilistic dimension reduction, scalable inferential methods, analysis of non-Euclidean data.  (Crosslisted course offered as STAT 437, DATA 437.)
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: DATA
records.title: Statistical Foundations in Artificial Intelligence
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: DATA 219; DATA 324; MATH 216; STAT/DATA 360.
records.description: Statistical foundations of AI, including data ethics, probability for generative models, inference, predictive modeling, statistical learning, and deep learning, emphasizing theory, real-world applications, and ethical implications.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: DATA
records.title: Mathematical Foundations of AI
records.description: Foundational AI topics including linear algebra, optimization, graph theory, graph neural networks, manifold learning, kernel methods, function spaces, probabilistic and decision-theoretic models, and ethical considerations.

records.subject: DATA
records.title: Prompt Engineering for Data Analytics
records.description: Designing and refining prompts for LLMs to clean, transform, visualize, and narrate data; emphasizing hands-on projects, ethical considerations, and evaluation of outputs using open-source tools and collaborative platforms.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: DATA
records.title: Special Topics II
records.prerequisiteText: Course prerequisite: Admitted to the major in Data Analytics; junior standing.
records.description: Skills and concepts for analyzing real data using coding software.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: DATA
records.title: Internship
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite:  By department permission; admitted to the major in Data Analytics; junior standing.
records.description: Experiential learning and career development through professional practice.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: DATA
records.title: Special Problems
records.description: Independent study conducted under the jurisdiction of an approving faculty member; may include independent research studies in technical or specialized problems; selection and analysis of specified readings; development of a creative project; or field experiences.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.
